description: This file contains a PHP trait `S3ClientTrait` which provides S3-specific methods for interacting with Amazon S3 storage within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes functionalities such as uploading, copying, deleting objects, and managing bucket regions.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Synchronously uploads an object to S3 by calling the asynchronous upload method and waiting for its completion.

methods.name: uploadAsync
methods.description: Begins an asynchronous upload of an object to S3, returning a promise.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Synchronously copies an object within S3 by calling the asynchronous copy method and waiting for its completion.

methods.name: copyAsync
methods.description: Begins an asynchronous copy of an object within S3, returning a promise.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapper
methods.description: Registers the stream wrapper for S3.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapperV2
methods.description: Registers the V2 stream wrapper for S3 with specific parameters.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjects
methods.description: Deletes objects matching a prefix or regex asynchronously and waits for completion.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjectsAsync
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous deletion of objects matching a prefix or regex in a bucket, returning a promise.

methods.name: uploadDirectory
methods.description: Uploads a directory to S3 synchronously by calling the async version and waiting.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Begins an asynchronous upload of a directory to S3, returning a promise.

methods.name: downloadBucket
methods.description: Downloads the contents of a bucket to a local directory synchronously.

methods.name: downloadBucketAsync
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous download of a bucket's contents to a local directory.

methods.name: determineBucketRegion
methods.description: Synchronously determines the region of a bucket.

methods.name: determineBucketRegionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously determines the region of a bucket, returning a promise.

methods.name: determineBucketRegionFromExceptionBody
methods.description: Parses the bucket region from an exception response body.

methods.name: doesBucketExist
methods.description: Checks if a bucket exists.

methods.name: doesBucketExistV2
methods.description: Checks if a bucket exists with additional handling for specific error codes.

methods.name: doesObjectExist
methods.description: Checks if an object exists within a bucket.

methods.name: doesObjectExistV2
methods.description: Checks if an object exists within a bucket, considering delete markers.

methods.name: useDeleteMarkers
methods.description: Determines if delete markers are used for object existence.

methods.name: checkExistenceWithCommand
methods.description: Executes a command to check resource existence, handling exceptions accordingly.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to execute a command - to be implemented by the class using this trait.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Abstract method to get a command object - to be implemented.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Abstract method to get handler list - to be implemented.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Abstract method to get an iterator over resources - to be implemented.
